_real_world.variant_scope: Type 093B (Shang-III) SSN; also used for Type 093A per the same reuse rationale as the bow sonar module.
hulls: Type 093B (Shang-III) hull numbers not individually public

_provenance.modeling_note: USNI/ONI sourcing (A/B-tier) and general PLAN-submarine literature describe a towed-array fit as standard for modern Chinese SSNs including the Shang-III, but no designation, aperture, or detection-range figure is public. Modeled as a passive-only towed array following the repo's convention (longer range, lower self-noise, and no baffle-exclusion cone relative to the bow sonar module), matching the surface-combatant towed-array/VDS module's design pattern but tuned for a quieter SSN platform.

sonar.mode.note: Passive: no active-ping capability is reported for any PLAN SSN towed array

sonar.max_range_m.note: no public figure; engineering estimate above the packet's Type 093B bow sonar module, reflecting a towed array's lower self-noise and deeper/quieter deployment, scaled below the repo's US SSN towed-array convention given the absence of PLAN-specific sourcing

sonar.scan_period_s.note: no public figure; engineering estimate typical of a towed-array processing cycle

sonar.detection_threshold_db.note: no public figure; engineering estimate better than the bow sonar module, consistent with a lower-self-noise towed array

sonar.track_memory_s.note: no public figure; engineering estimate longer than the bow sonar module

sonar.bearing_noise_std_deg.note: no public figure; engineering estimate better than the bow sonar module

sonar.range_noise_std_m.note: no public figure; engineering estimate consistent with a passive array's coarser ranging via target motion analysis

sonar.directivity_gain_db.note: no public figure; engineering estimate higher than the bow sonar module, consistent with a long towed array's directivity advantage

sonar.self_noise_per_speed_db.note: no public figure; engineering estimate lower than the bow sonar module, reflecting isolation from ownship machinery/flow noise

sonar.ambient_noise_db.note: standard engine ambient-ocean-noise scaffold constant, matched to the packet's bow sonar module

sonar.source_level_reference_db.note: 0.0: passive-only array has no active source level

sonar.source_level_speed_factor_db.note: 0.0: not applicable to a passive-only array

sonar.transmission_loss_alpha_db_per_km.note: no public figure; carried close to the packet's bow sonar module (generic underwater transmission-loss constant)

sonar.layer_break_penalty_db.note: no public figure; engineering estimate slightly lower than the bow sonar module

sonar.convergence_zone_bonus_m.note: no public figure; engineering estimate scaled with max_range_m, above the bow sonar module

sonar.baffle_exclusion_deg.note: 0.0: a towed array deployed astern of the boat has a negligible baffle-exclusion cone compared to a bow-mounted array

sonar.ownship_quieting_speed_mps.note: no public figure; engineering estimate higher than the bow sonar module, reflecting reduced sensitivity to ownship speed/flow noise

sonar.active_ping_source_level_db.note: 0.0: no active-ping capability modeled for this passive-only towed array

sonar.confirm_hits_m.note: standard engine detection-confirmation default, matched to the packet's bow sonar module

sonar.confirm_window_n.note: standard engine detection-confirmation default, slightly larger window reflecting slower passive-array confirmation

sonar.passive_only.note: true: no active-ping capability is reported for any PLAN SSN towed array

sonar.bearing_only.note: false: modeled with target-motion-analysis-derived range, consistent with the packet's surface-combatant towed-array/VDS module convention

modeling_notes: Reused for both Type 093A and Type 093B towed array per this packet's decision to differentiate the two hulls by VLS/weapon loadout rather than by an unsourced towed-array performance delta.
